div.div: مِنْضَحَةٌ (L, K) as also مِنْضَخَةٌ, (IAar, L,) vulg. ↓ نَضَّاحَةٌ , (Az,) i. q. زَرَّاقَةٌ, (IAar, L, [in some copies of the K زُرَّقة; in the CK زَرافَة] i. e. An instrument made of copper or brass for shooting forth naphtha [into a besieged place: mentioned in several histories]. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
